senses.def: Supposing that, assuming that, in the circumstances that; suppositive used to introduce a condition that may be (or prove to be) either true or false.
ex: I'll do it next week if I have time.
I'll come only if you do the driving.

senses.def: A keyword that invokes conditional processing: in the event that a given condition is true, execute the given statement(s) (otherwise execute other statements).
ex: if A then B else C

senses.def: Supposing that; used with past or past perfect subjunctive to indicate a counterfactual or hypothetical condition.
ex: If she hadn't told me, I wouldn't know.
If I was rich, I'd live in a big house by the sea.

senses.def: Even if; even in the circumstances that.
ex: I wouldn't marry you if you were the last man on earth.
You're finishing your chowder if you sit there all afternoon!

senses.def: Considering the fact that; given that; introducing a condition that is known to be true.
ex: The drain's blocked — and if the drain's blocked, the water won't flow.
If you heat water to 100° C, it boils.

senses.def: Although; used to introduce a concession; may..but.
ex: He was a great friend, if a little stingy at the bar.
She won her team's admiration, if not the award, for her performance.

senses.def: Whether; used to introduce a noun clause, an indirect question, that functions as the direct object of certain verbs.
ex: I don't know if I want to go or not.
Quoth Matthew, “ […] / She doubts if two and two make four, / […] ”

senses.def: Introducing a relevance conditional; in case.
ex: I have leftover cake if you want some.
If you want to go home, I have the car keys.

senses.def: While; used to introduce a contrast.
An uncertainty, possibility, condition, doubt etc.
ex: The board can't approve this project; there are too many ifs.
